svg.title: Copilot and Fabric IQ evaluation accelerator: solution architecture
svg.desc: An evaluation script asks Microsoft 365 Copilot each golden question as a test user, compares the answer with the value from reference DAX on the certified semantic model, checks the cited report, reads workspace monitoring query logs to see which semantic model ran, and stores results in an Eventhouse that a Fabric app built with Rayfin reads through a Lakehouse SQL analytics endpoint.
